# Lico Arc Protocol

> LicoArc defines carrier-independent durable communication and live application capabilities. Nostr is an optional adapter for standard private-message reach and open enhanced contracts, not an identity or storage authority.


An Endpoint owns keys, plaintext, peer acceptance, approvals, effects, and authenticated confirmations. A Station carries opaque protected packets and has no trust authority. A Network supplies an interoperability context. An independently key-holding isolated runtime is an Endpoint; agent workflow and tool permissions belong to the application.

The website is an orientation layer. The public LicoArc repository owns normative meaning. The Markdown links below point directly to its maintained public sources.

## Nostr interoperability (V1 Candidate)

- [Nostr interoperability guide](https://licoarc.com/docs/nostr-interoperability/): Baseline private messages, enhanced account binding and explicit capabilities.
- [Exact binding definition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/spec/interop/v1/protocol.md): Immutable Candidate source, distinct from a runtime-support claim.

Nostr account keys and Endpoint keys remain separate. Standard NIP-44 is not claimed to have forward secrecy or post-quantum protection. Enhanced messages never silently downgrade or gain a weaker compatibility copy. Native proof and source checks do not certify this composite or any client implementation.

## Start here

- [Documentation overview](https://licoarc.com/docs/): Reading path and authority map.
- [Evaluating encrypted agent communication](https://licoarc.com/docs/#agent-communication): Identity, approvals, confirmations, and application responsibilities; no MCP or A2A interoperability claim.
- [Protocol product boundary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/PRODUCT.md): Product promise and current Candidate limits.
- [Core vocabulary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/CONTEXT.md): Endpoint, Station, Network, Group, and confirmation meanings.
- [Current status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/STATUS.md): Definition and verification facts separated from publication and runtime claims.

## Capability definitions

- [Foundation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/foundation-v1.md): Encoding, bounds, closed registries, and content identity.
- [Identity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/identity-v1.md): Self-certifying authority, independent devices, management, and recovery.
- [Pairwise protection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/pairwise-protection-v1.md): Hybrid establishment, authentication, and protected records.
- [Generic messaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/generic-messaging-v1.md): Namespaced application payloads and attachments.
- [Reliable exchange](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/reliable-exchange-v1.md): Durable intent, bounded processing turns, result facts, and recovery.
- [HTTPS transport](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/https-transport-v1.md): HTTP/2 and TLS 1.3 carrier boundaries.
- [Group collaboration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/group-collaboration-v1.md): Membership, versioned state, per-member projections, and partial failure.
- [Federation governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/docs/protocols/federation-governance-v1.md): Threshold evidence, recovery, and final local admission.

## Optional

- [Verification guide](https://licoarc.com/docs/verification/): Source integrity, conformance corpora, formal model limits, and deterministic artifacts.
- [Governance and license](https://licoarc.com/docs/governance/): Apache-2.0 and lifecycle boundaries.
- [Canonical repository](https://github.com/LicoLand/LicoArc): Machine-readable sources and human-readable projections.

## Current continuity revision

V1 / Generation 1 is Candidate / PARTIAL, new-session ineligible and publication ineligible pending formal proof requalification. Nostr is optional. Accepted work has no protocol-imposed lifetime; live capabilities update existing authorized conversations without rebinding.

- [Durable work and confirmation facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/spec/v1/reliable/continuity.md)
- [Live capability synchronization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/spec/v1/messaging/capabilities.md)
- [Group history and fork recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/spec/v1/group/continuity.md)
- [Required new security evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LicoLand/LicoArc/802a023cc0e02e78fcb52780311e3236bc75af90/formal/requalification.json)
